field_changes.old: Edit your available weights right from the workout screen — tap ⋯ on any exercise to update your plates or dumbbells and watch planned sets adjust automatically. Adaptive Plans now properly pause weight progressions during deload weeks. Returning users get a "Continue as" shortcut at login, and weight entry now accepts your local decimal separator. Plus a handful of bug fixes.
field_changes.new: Your adaptive plan's week preview now shows exactly why exercises were swapped — injury, difficulty, or equipment — grouped by movement pattern in a new update card. The activity feed refreshes instantly when you delete a logged session too. Empty weeks in the weekly review now correctly show No Data, and onboarding is streamlined so new members get to their first workout faster. Plus a handful of bug fixes.
